Name: Paimon Fairy Trinket (CP)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]

Ever wanted emergency food and a little fairy just isn't enough for you? Look no further! This mod retextures the fairy trinket to appear as Paimon from Genshin Impact, everyones favorite emergency food.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Not compatible with other CP mods that change the fairy trinket obviously.
